description: Lightning bolts summoned on lightning rods: a struck rod gives 15 for 8 ticks and strongly powers the block it stands on (lamps beside those blocks); redstone wire next to a rod connects to it; an oxidized rod becomes a plain one, a waxed one stays; a rod on a wall; a struck rod pushed by a piston keeps its power where it lands for a new 8 ticks (the lamp beside it there).
